recipes.decision: How has the observed policy rate developed as of the decision date?

sections.interpretation: Which policy communications or releases are needed to interpret the observed path?
caveats: Rate observations do not establish the causes of subsequent economic outcomes.

recipes.action: Review dated policy communications and the release-vintage context.

recipes.decision: How do observed unemployment and growth measures compare across countries?

sections.interpretation: Are labor-market definitions and release vintages comparable across countries?
Do the growth observations use the same indicator and seasonal-adjustment basis?
caveats: Cross-country co-movement is descriptive and does not establish causation.

recipes.action: Confirm definitions and release vintages before drawing cross-country conclusions.
